# Trademark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Trademark>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified trademark right over a mark — binding the mark, its holder, the registration number and the ™/®/status value. Aligned (by reference) to [schema:Brand](https://schema.org/Brand), the WIPO trademark vocabulary and Wikidata.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a trademark right over a mark when its holder, registration number, or ™/®/status must be recorded — distinct from the mark itself ([`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating the right with the sign it protects (the brand/logo is a [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md)) and avoid deleting a lapsed registration — keep it and set [`gmeow:trademarkStatusExpired`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusExpired.md) with [`gmeow:validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md), bind it to its [`gmeow:Mark`](gmeow-Mark.md) with [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkMark.md), attribute the proprietor with [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkHolder.md), carry [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](../properties/gmeow-registrationNumber.md) and [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkStatus.md); link from the entity with [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](../properties/gmeow-hasTrademark.md).

### Examples

- ex:blackcatTM a [`gmeow:Trademark`](gmeow-Trademark.md); [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkMark.md) ex:blackcatMark; [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkHolder.md) ex:blackcat; [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) [`gmeow:trademarkStatusRegistered`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusRegistered.md).
